title: World generator qualifying social event injection
objective: Modify back/app/world/generator.py so that the fallback ambient cycle path produces qualifying SocialEventSpec values (confrontation or withdrawal) at a controlled low frequency — approximately 1 in 7 fallback days — enabling the existing T4 event-aware detection seam to trigger during real simulation runs.
exact_scope: The change is confined to the fallback path inside _fallback_snapshot() in generator.py. Days covered by a registered arc (Days 3–16) are left unchanged. The injection logic must be deterministic: the same world day always returns the same result. The two qualifying event types must match the types listed in T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES in tick_bridge.py (confrontation, withdrawal). No other files are modified.
constraints: Do not modify AppraisalSignal field definitions.
Do not activate T4 through any path other than social event-aware activation (the Phase 26B approved path).
Do not expand the bridge for deferred ticks T3, T5, T6, T7, T8.
Do not touch arc-covered days (Days 3–16); those must continue to return social_event=None unless the arc phase itself defines one.
Days tested by test_generator_produces_social_event_none (days 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 16, 17, 20, 24) must remain social_event=None after the change.
Injection must be deterministic: same world_day always yields the same social_event value.
Injected event types must come from {confrontation, withdrawal} only, matching T4_QUALIFYING_EVENT_TYPES.
All existing tests in back/tests/ must continue to pass after the change.
LLM does not write ledger values directly — all settlement flows through the engine.
The SocialEventSpec schema (Phase 26A) must not be altered.
acceptance_criteria: get_world_snapshot() returns a non-None social_event on at least one fallback-path day within a 7-day window (e.g., day 21, 28, or 35).
The returned social_event.event_type is either confrontation or withdrawal on injection days.
Days 3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 16, 17, 20, 24 all return social_event=None (preserving the Phase 26A test contract).
The same world_day consistently returns the same social_event value across repeated calls (determinism).
Calling get_world_snapshot() on any injected day and passing the result through _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event() in tick_bridge.py returns a non-None qualifying event.
All 900 existing tests pass without modification.
The change is committed to git — verified by at least one new commit containing the modified generator.py.
required_tests: For world days that fall on the injection trigger (e.g., day 21, 28, 35), the generator must return a SocialEventSpec whose event_type is confrontation or withdrawal.
For all days covered by existing schema tests (3, 5, 7, 10, 12, 16, 17, 20, 24), the generator must return social_event=None — existing test_generator_produces_social_event_none must still pass.
Calling the generator twice for the same day must produce the same social_event value (determinism requirement).

A qualifying social event returned by the generator on an injection day must pass through _detect_qualifying_t4_social_event() and return a non-None result, confirming the T4 detection seam can now fire.
No existing test in back/tests/ may fail as a result of this change.
non_goals: Do not modify arc-defined events or add social events to arc phases (Days 3–16).
Do not implement T4 routing or filtering based on social_event.target_id.
Do not change the T4 settlement logic, bridge architecture, or AppraisalSignal schema.
Do not expand bridge coverage to T3, T5, T6, T7, or T8.
Do not redesign the world event taxonomy or introduce new SocialEventType values.
Do not modify any test files — acceptance is judged against existing tests plus the criteria above.
Do not produce LLM-driven or stochastic event generation — all output must remain deterministic.
